notes: JP/KR depth batch (researched by main agent after subagent content-filter kills). Verdict: ALL mainstream JP contract brands require Japanese residence (zairyu card) and have no idle PAYG mode — recorded as observation+hold negative knowledge. Existing povo/mobal/sakura remain the viable JP paths. Korea: KT official requires visa >=90 days; long-term retention needs ARC. FX JPY->CNY 0.048.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Requires Japanese Residence Card (zairyu card) with >=3 months visa validity remaining (all residence statuses accepted), Rakuten ID, and credit card (Visa/MC/JCB/AmEx; overseas-issued cards often work but sometimes declined). SIM/eSIM delivered to Japanese address.

keep.action: Official SAIKYO Plan detail page: tiered pricing, cheapest tier 3GB = 1,078 yen/mo incl tax. No PAYG idle mode — cancel = number lost. Retention = keep paying monthly.

routes.chinaActivation: Not possible — requires Japanese residence docs and Japan delivery/activation.
routes.kyc: Residence Card (zairyu card) REQUIRED, both sides uploaded; visa >=3 months remaining. Not available to tourists or overseas users.
routes.payment: Visa/MC/JCB/AmEx or JP bank transfer; overseas cards sometimes declined.
routes.holdReason: Requires Japanese residence (zairyu card + 3-month visa validity). For non-residents, use povo (residents only too) / mobal / sakura instead.
routes.tariffSummary: SAIKYO Plan: 3GB tier 1,078 yen/mo (tax incl); 20GB 2,178 yen; unlimited 3,278 yen.
